newsitem.title: USA: IntegraMed backs Q2, 1997 EPS estimates.
newsitem.headline: IntegraMed backs Q2, 1997 EPS estimates.

text.p: IntegraMed America Inc said Wednesday it backs analyst estimates of $0.01 a share earnings for second quarter and $0.06 a share for the full year 1997.
"We are in agreement with that," Gerardo Canet, president and chief executive of IntegraMed, said of the second quarter estimate.
He added the full year estimate is a "reasonable expectation".
IntegraMed reported a 1996 loss of $0.09 a share.

In an interview after his presentation at the Piper Jaffray conference here, Canet said the company has received comments regarding a $10 million share direct placement announced in May and does not foresee any problems.
"We'll respond to them tomorrow and hopefully print the prospectus on Monday or Tuesday and circulate it," Canet said.
IntgegraMed has said it will use a substantial portion of the proceeds for its previously announced acquisition of Fertility Centers of Illinois SC.
IntegraMed is a physician practice management company specializing in women's health care.
